content: Refactor token refresh so concurrent requests share one refresh. Keep the public API unchanged, and add a regression test.

content.text: I found two callers refreshing the same token independently. I’ll share the in-flight promise and cover the concurrent-request case.

## One refresh, shared safely

Concurrent callers now await the **same in-flight promise**. The promise is cleared on success or failure, so the next request can retry.

- Kept the `refreshToken()` API unchanged
- Added a regression test for two concurrent callers
- Checked the rejection path so failures do not lock out future refreshes

**Demo verification:** 12 fixture tests passed. Review the diff in Changes before merging.

This is a fictional capture scenario, not a live project run.
